result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and a mature tree canopy that provides shade and a sense of enclosure. However, the intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and visible curb ramps, and parked cars near the corner may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked intersection crossing
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks at the junction makes pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner on the right may hide pedestrians from the view of approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings to clearly delineate pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corner to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban sidewalk adjacent to a brick building with mixed-use frontage. Large street trees and parked cars significantly reduce the effective walking space and visibility, though the environment is generally low-speed and residential in character.

hazards.name: Restricted Walkway Width
hazards.description: Mature trees planted in the center of the narrow sidewalk create pinch points that may be difficult for people with mobility aids or strollers to navigate.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the sidewalk where trees are located

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars create a continuous visual barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion
interventions.description: Reallocate a portion of the on-street parking lane to widen the sidewalk, allowing for a clear pedestrian through-zone alongside the existing trees.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the nearest intersection or mid-block to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and mature street trees. While the low-speed environment is generally conducive to walking, the lack of marked crossings and the presence of parked cars that may obstruct sightlines are notable deficiencies.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks at the intersection ahead, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian crossing behavior.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection with Alder St.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban residential street lined with multi-story row houses. A continuous paved sidewalk is present directly adjacent to the curb, though it lacks a buffer from the parallel-parked vehicles that partially obstruct visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the line of sight between drivers and pedestrians, especially children, who might step into the street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.
